name: Rose hip
short: A mechanism-focused review states that trials showed excellent tolerability; a meta-analysis of three manufacturer-supported trials said safety still needs a large, long-term trial.
text: The background of a mechanism-focused review states that several randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind studies of rose hip, alone or in combination, showed excellent tolerability. A meta-analysis of three manufacturer-supported trials in osteoarthritis (287 patients, median duration 3 months) concluded that safety still needs evaluation and independent replication in a large, long-term trial. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
